claims.claim_text: BigBear.ai is a federal contractor whose customers are primarily DoD/national-security agencies; the majority of employees hold active security clearances; mission-ready AI sold to U.S. government.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai Holdings
claims.source_quote: BigBear.ai is a leading provider of Edge AI-powered decision intelligence solutions for national security ... The majority of our employees are security-cleared ... we have deep trusting relationships with unique and discerning customers in the U.S. government

claims.claim_text: ConductorOS — BigBear.ai's edge AI / sensor orchestration platform — was central to U.S./Australian joint military exercise Talisman Sabre in 2025.
claims.subject: ConductorOS / BigBear.ai
claims.source_quote: In 2025, ConductorOS was central to exercise Talisman Sabre a joint exercise to strengthen military interoperability between allied forces ... between U.S., Australian Forces, and more than two dozen other nations.

claims.claim_text: Three-acquisition rollup: BigBear.ai acquired Pangiam (March 2024), and most recently Ask Sage (Dec 31 2025 for $271.6M), plus the CargoSeer asset purchase (Jan 16 2026, $5M). Each ostensibly serves the same defense/national-security AI thesis.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.source_quote: On December 31, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of Ask Sage ... Of the total purchase consideration of $271.6 million, $267.6 million was paid in cash ... On January 16, 2026, the Company acquired certain assets and liabilities of CargoSeer Ltd ... for $5.0 million

kwargs.parent_thesis: BigBear.ai provides edge AI-powered decision intelligence for U.S. national security / defense / intelligence customers, plus travel-and-trade biometrics; majority of staff hold security clearances; sells mission-ready AI to DoD/IC.

acquisitions.target_business: computer vision / biometrics / digital identity / travel and trade
FedRAMP-authorized generative AI platform for DoD/IC (IL5/IL6/TS)
AI cargo scanning / Non-Intrusive Inspection for customs / ports of entry

claims.claim_text: Ask Sage is used by '16,000 government teams, 100,000 Department of War users, and 2,500 companies' and is the first FedRAMP-authorized generative AI platform certified for DoD IL5/IL6/TS use.
claims.subject: Ask Sage (BigBear.ai subsidiary)
claims.object_value: 16k gov teams; 100k DoW users; FedRAMP IL5/IL6/TS
claims.source_quote: Ask Sage is — as of January 2026 — used by more than 16,000 government teams, 100,000 Department of War users, and 2,500 companies

claims.claim_text: Patents / IP — BigBear.ai claims it protects 'proprietary inventions relevant to our business through patent protection in the United States and abroad' and lists IP as 'valuable and important', positioning itself as an AI-tech IP leader (digital identity / biometrics / computer vision / edge AI).
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.object_value: claimed US/abroad patents in AI / biometrics / edge
claims.source_quote: We seek to protect our proprietary inventions relevant to our business through patent protection in the United States and abroad

claims.claim_text: BigBear.ai raised $637M in gross proceeds via three ATM Sales Agreements during 2025 and issued 142M new shares; share count rose from 251.5M (Dec 2024) to 437.0M (Dec 2025) — a 74% dilution in one year.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.object_value: $637M raised, 142M shares issued in 2025; share count 251.5M -> 437.0M
claims.source_quote: The Company completed the May 2024 Sales Agreement, the June 2025 Sales Agreement and the August 2025 Sales Agreement during the year ended December 31, 2025 for total gross proceeds of $637 million and 142 million shares issued. ... Common stock outstanding at the period end 436,955,655 [vs] 251,554,378

claims.claim_text: BigBear.ai operates leased facilities at six primary locations (McLean VA HQ, Ann Arbor MI, Chantilly VA, Columbia MD, London UK, Abu Dhabi UAE) plus Charlottesville VA — and operates near 'major national security or civil space community facilities'.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.source_quote: We occupy approximately fifty nine thousand square feet of leased building space at six primary locations. ... McLean, Virginia (Corporate Headquarters) Ann Arbor, Michigan Chantilly, Virginia Columbia, Maryland London, United Kingdom Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

claims.claim_text: ICFR / Internal Controls — management concludes ICFR was effective as of Dec 31, 2025, after completing remediation of a previously disclosed material weakness related to technical accounting. Ask Sage (acquired Dec 31 2025) is excluded from the ICFR assessment.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.object_value: Previously-disclosed material weakness; remediation completed by filing date
claims.source_quote: As of the date of this filing, management completed the implementation of our remediation efforts of the material weakness related to technical accounting. ... management concluded that as of December 31, 2025, the Company s internal control over financial reporting was effective.

claims.claim_text: BigBear.ai disclosed a heavily federal customer concentration with revenue mix 61% time-and-material and 25% fixed-price; sales cycle is 12+ months for government customers. The framework expects 'Customer A' to be identifiable as a federal prime/agency.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.source_quote: For the years ended December 31, 2025 revenue from time-and-material and fixed-price contracts was 61% and 25% of revenue, respectively. ... Our government customers often undertake a significant evaluation process that results in a lengthy sales cycle, in many cases over twelve months

claims.claim_text: BigBear.ai has 579 employees as of Dec 31 2025, headquartered in McLean Virginia; ~67% are software engineers / data scientists / cloud engineers / analysts / cyber SMEs.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.object_value: 579 employees; 67% technical roles; McLean VA HQ
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had 579 employees, the vast majority of which are employed in the United States and hold an active security clearance. Approximately 67% of our workforce comprises software engineers, data scientists, cloud/systems engineers, analysts, and cyber subject-matter experts.
